title: The stated goal 'reach a REAL ending within 300 turns' was not reachable for a companion-recruiting, side-quest-engaging explorer. Finishing Act 1 (Vale of Ash) fully — 3 companions, 3 verses, the crown, the Barrow Doors choice — plus light follow-on exploration consumed the entire 300-turn budget by itself. The very next quest ('The Gray') then requires resting three more of six remaining holds, or completing two full Watch services, or buying Free Company passage, just to open the road toward the next milestone (Coldpass/Marrowgate) — nowhere close to reachable in 300 turns even played efficiently.
where: overall campaign structure / status after Act I completion
